Scarlet & Violet series · DRI

Destined Rivals

Released May 30, 2025 · 244 cards

StandardExpanded

Destined Rivals is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on May 30, 2025. Its main set has 182 cards, plus 62 secret rares numbered beyond the set (244 in total). It includes 209 Pokémon, 34 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
